scripts.db:migrate:local: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute fc-admin --local --file=$f; done
scripts.db:migrate:prod: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute fc-admin --remote --file=$f; done
scripts.users: wrangler d1 execute fc-admin --remote --command="SELECT email, nombre, rol, activo FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC"
